description.zh: 边缘应用的ID。在[边缘计算控制台](https://iot.console.aliyun.com/le/instance/list)的**应用管理**页面中，鼠标悬浮在目标应用名称上获取ID。
description.en: The ID of the edge application. You can obtain the ID by hovering your mouse over the name of the target application on the **Application Management** page in the [Edge Computing console](https://iot.console.aliyun.com/le/instance/list).

description.zh:
边缘实例的ID。在[边缘计算控制台](https://iot.console.aliyun.com/le/instance/list)的**边缘实例**页面中，鼠标悬浮在目标边缘实例名称上获取ID。

您也可以调用[QueryEdgeInstance](~~135214~~)接口获取。
description.en:
The ID of the edge instance. You can obtain the ID by hovering your mouse over the name of the target edge instance on the **Edge Instances** page in the [Edge Computing console](https://iot.console.aliyun.com/le/instance/list).

You can also call the [QueryEdgeInstance](~~135214~~) API to obtain the ID.

description.zh: 实例ID。公共实例不传此参数，企业版实例需传入。
description.en: The instance ID. Do not pass this parameter for public instances; pass it for Enterprise instances.

title.zh: 从边缘实例中移除边缘应用
title.en: Remove an edge application from an edge instance

descriptions.zh:
## 限制条件
单阿里云账号调用该接口的每秒请求数（QPS）最大限制为5。

> RAM用户共享主账号配额。
descriptions.en:
## Condition
Each Alibaba Cloud account can invoke this API up to 5 times per second (queries per second (QPS)).

> Resource Access Management (RAM) users share the quota of the Alibaba Cloud account.
